games.headline: Jalen Johnson scores 26 points with four steals as Hawks overcome slow start to beat Hornets 111-97
games.desc: — Jalen Johnson scored 26 points, Aaron Wiggins bailed out Atlanta's depleted backcourt with 19 points and the Hawks overcame a slow start to beat the Charlotte Hornets 111-97 on...

games.headline: Franz Wagner scores 35, hits late jumper to lift Magic over Nets 113-111
games.desc: — Franz Wagner scored 35 points, including a game-winning jumper with 2.4 seconds left, and the Orlando Magic beat the Brooklyn Nets 113-111 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

games.headline: James Harden posts 26th 50-point game, moves past Kobe as Cavaliers beat Pacers 128-119
games.desc: — James Harden scored 51 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Indiana Pacers 128-119 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

games.headline: Scottie Barnes scores 29, including key layup, as Raptors end skid with 105-102 win over Pistons
games.desc: — Scottie Barnes scored 29 points, including a layup with 14 seconds left, and the Toronto Raptors ended their six-game losing streak with a 105-102 win over the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

games.headline: Davis and Dybantsa help the Wizards knock off the Bulls 98-94 in NBA Cup action
games.desc: — Anthony Davis had 36 points and 11 rebounds, and the Washington Wizards beat the Chicago Bulls 98-94 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.

games.headline: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 40 as Thunder beat Pelicans 126-120 in NBA Cup
games.desc: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder rallied in the fourth quarter for a 126-120 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday night to improve to 2-1 in NBA Cup play.

games.headline: Devin Booker scores 23 points and Suns pull away in final minute for 111-101 win over Jazz
games.desc: — Devin Booker had 23 points and the Phoenix Suns scored the final six of the game to pull away late and beat the Utah Jazz 111-101 in an NBA Cup matchup Friday night.

games.headline: Nikola Jokic's big 2nd half sends the Nuggets to a 133-124 win over the Rockets
games.desc: — Nikola Jokic had 26 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds as the Denver Nuggets defeated the Houston Rockets 133-124 in a back-and-forth NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Luka Doncic scores 25, Lakers barely hold off Kings 106-104 on LaVine's miss at the buzzer
games.desc: — Luka Doncic had 25 points and eight assists, Quentin Grimes hit a tiebreaking 3-pointer with 57 seconds to play, and the Los Angeles Lakers rallied in the fourth quarter for their 10th win in 11 games, 106-104 over the Sacramento Kings on Friday night.
